description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter component, verifying its decision logic for session matching, prompting behavior based on security levels and fallback handling.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompterTests
classes.description: A struct containing various test cases for ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter, ensuring it behaves correctly under different scenarios.

methods.name: session match prefers active session
methods.description: Tests whether the prompt correctly matches an active session based on session strings.

methods.name: session fallback uses recent activity
methods.description: Ensures that recent activity triggers prompts when no active session is present.

methods.name: default behavior matches mode
methods.description: Verifies that the prompting behavior aligns with the configured mode (local or remote).

methods.name: askAlwaysPromptsRegardlessOfSecurity
methods.description: Checks that all security settings with 'always' ask prompt the user.

methods.name: askOnMissPromptsOnlyForAllowlist
methods.description: Ensures prompts are shown only for allowlist security level when asking on miss.

methods.name: askOffNeverPrompts
methods.description: Verifies that no prompts are shown when ask setting is turned off.

methods.name: fallbackAllowlistAllowsMatchingResolvedPath
methods.description: Tests that commands matching allowlist patterns are permitted.

methods.name: fallbackAllowlistDeniesAllowlistMiss
methods.description: Ensures commands not matching allowlist patterns are denied.

methods.name: fallbackFullAllowsWhenPromptCannotBeShown
methods.description: Checks that fallback full level allows commands when prompts cannot be shown.
